title: Operations Control Officer
description:
We at PNG Air pride ourselves as the leading domestic airline operating over 26 ports across the length and breadth of Papua New Guinea as the Airline of Choice. Operating the largest fleet of ATR 72-600 series in the region. We are committed to providing affordable world class experience with value fares and unbeatable cargo rates, ensuring reliable and safe on time service to our valued customers and stakeholders.
Operations Control Officer
An opportunity has risen within the
Operations
Division for an
Operations Control Officer.
Reporting to the
Operations Control Supervisor
, this position is responsible for the management of the Operations Planner, including integrated flight dispatch and flight following functions.
Key Responsibilities
The Operations Controllers shall be responsible to the Operations Control Supervisor for the following:
Day Shift
Monitoring and recording the progress of all flights on day of operation on the whiteboard, using information from Skynet, communications with port staff, flight crew and Flight Services as required.
Updating MELs on the board to reflect latest reports from Continuing Airworthiness and the MRO
Completing the Daily Actual Movement work sheet
Communicating changes of plan, changes of aircraft and/or crew, flight delays and cancellations to concerned stakeholders.
Printing and checking latest Air Maestro flight and duty time reports
Preparing and completing Flight Summary Sheets
Checking serviceability of aircraft plus hours remaining to maintenance and any expiring MELs; updating the board and adjusting operations for the day if necessary.
Night Shift
Preparing and distributing Version 2 of the Daily Movement Sheet considering changes to aircraft and crew allocation as required
Preparing and distributing the Flight Summary sheet
Updating flight following details into Skynet
Preparing, distributing and filing crew transport pick up sheets
Preparing, printing and filing the Daily Departure Summary
Preparing and distributing the final Daily Movement Sheet for the next day’s operations
Preparing the provisional flying programme for the following day on the Operations Admin Computer and whiteboard, in preparation for completing and sending out by the Operations Supervisor on Day Shift
Other duties as required from time to time by the Operations Control Supervisor.
Education/Qualifications
Minimum of Grade 12 education or equivalent to diploma and degree
Strong customer service skills
Good computer skills
Must be able to work on the weekends/ on shifts
Live or reside within the city
